sections.description: Elementor widget that shows a YouTube channel's playlists as tabs in a grid, carousel or featured-player layout. New videos appear automatically.
sections.changelog:
0.5.1

  • Tab alignment option (left, center, right or full width) under Style → Tabs, settable per breakpoint.

0.5.0

  • Updates are only offered while the site's YouTube API key works. The Plugins screen shows why when they're paused.
  • The API key status now keeps itself current from the daily video refresh, so a deleted or blocked key is noticed automatically.

0.4.0

  • Automatic updates: new versions now appear on the Plugins screen like any other plugin.

0.3.2

  • Style controls for the "Load more" button: alignment, spacing, typography, colors (normal and hover), border and padding.

0.3.1

  • Fixed the Playlists panel going blank in the Elementor editor.
  • Removed the widget header (eyebrow and heading).

0.3.0

  • Elementor widget with grid, carousel and featured-player layouts.
  • Playlist toggles with drag-to-reorder in the editor.

0.2.0

  • YouTube data layer with a daily cache and last-good-copy backup.
  • API key status display and "Test a channel" tool on the settings screen.

0.1.0

  • Plugin scaffold, settings screen and VideoObject structured data.
